hypothesis: On data_seed 1 with m2 fixed at 0.5, the N=64 to N=128 trained force R2 drop (about 0.065 / 0.088 at 3000 steps) persists at 6000 steps. N=128 seeds 20-21 (4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls) stay at least 0.04 below the same seed's N=64 layer-4 probes_final trained force R2 (0.795 seed 20, 0.790 seed 21). Values come from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and the layer is reported; a cross-layer comparison is flagged. Horizon check: step-3000 trained force R2 must be within 0.03 of the 3000-step N=128 data_seed 1 runs (0.730 / 0.715).
expected_if_true: In both seeds, final trained force R2 is <= 0.755 (seed 20) and <= 0.750 (seed 21). accel_step headroom-normalised margin is in [0.60, 0.80].
expected_if_false: In both seeds, final trained force R2 is >= 0.775 (seed 20) and >= 0.770 (seed 21), i.e. within 0.02 of N=64. A split between seeds counts as inconclusive.
